smells.finding: All functions are short and single-purpose: compound_softness (~17 lines), run_purpose_score (~8), track_evolution_score (~33 incl. docstring), fuel_proximity (~8), observation_features (~9-line body), observation_weight (~8-line body), _sigmoid (~7). No method approaches long-method territory.
ObservationFeatures (4 fields) and WeightParams (5 fields) are small frozen dataclasses with no behavior beyond field storage.
No literal or structural duplication found; track_evolution_score's two normalization branches (within-session vs saturating) implement genuinely different formulas, not copy-pasted logic.

observation_features reads latent.fuel_kg_est/compound/run_purpose, but FpLapLatent is a passive value object with no behavior (per fp_lap_latent.py's own docstring, an EMERGENT per-lap latent-state record). A pure feature-extraction function operating on a data-only object is the standard functional-core pattern, not envy toward a behavior-bearing class.

The four related feature values are grouped into ObservationFeatures (the clump cure, not the smell); fuel_kg_est/quali_fuel_kg are two independently-meaningful values passed once each, not a repeated ad hoc bag.
compound and run_purpose are raw str (matched via dict lookup) rather than enums.

override.repo_standard: fp_lap_latent.py (G2, frozen/out-of-scope per this gate's handoff) already types FpLapLatent.compound: str and .run_purpose: str directly from FastF1's SOFT/MEDIUM/HARD/... label convention and the C1-C5 raw-code convention (GLOSSARY.md: 'compound | Pirelli tire specification ... Stored in circuits/compounds.yaml' as strings project-wide); this module only consumes that existing typed contract.
override.reason: Introducing an enum boundary here would require touching fp_lap_latent.py's FpLapLatent, which the handoff's Allowed Scope explicitly excludes ("Do NOT touch session_estimator.py... "; FpLapLatent itself is G2, frozen). Matching the upstream string convention is the one-canonical-representation choice, not an unexamined primitive habit -- the module's own compound_softness/run_purpose_score already centralize all string-matching into two named lookup tables plus a documented neutral fallback, which is the mitigation this smell usually calls for.

smells.finding: observation_features takes latent (positional) plus 3 keyword-only params; observation_weight takes features plus 1 keyword-only param. No list approaches long-parameter-list territory.
Self-contained new module with zero current callers (grep confirms no other src/ file imports fp_representativeness yet); a future change here has no fan-out today.
The module has one cohesive reason to change (representativeness-weighting policy); no mixed responsibilities.
No chain deeper than one attribute access (e.g. latent.fuel_kg_est) found anywhere in the module.

WeightParams as a separate injectable dataclass looks like abstraction-for-its-own-sake but is directly load-bearing: the handoff names G6 as the concrete, already-planned consumer that fits WeightParams on train weekends, and the test suite exercises the params= override path (test_custom_params_are_respected). The C-number-aware compound branch is an explicit handoff requirement ('C-number aware if present'), not an unused hook.

Docstrings document WHY (decision candidates, calibration-placeholder flags, leakage/emergence guards) for code that is already short and clear on its own; they are not compensating for tangled logic.
